patches.rationale: The bug is that `dict(reservations)` collapses repeated SKU entries, keeping only the last quantity. Fix by iterating over every reservation tuple and subtracting each quantity, clamping at zero, ignoring unknown SKUs, and building a fresh dict so inputs are not mutated. Add a new regression test file covering the literal example, repeated SKUs, clamping, unknown SKUs, input preservation, return type/keys, and preserved existing behavior.
contract_tests: All reservation quantities for a SKU are subtracted, including repeated SKU entries — test_repeated_sku_reservations_are_all_subtracted (2+3 subtracted, not just last value).
Resulting available quantity is clamped at zero (never negative) — test_over_reservation_clamps_at_zero asserts {'A': 0}.
Reservations for SKUs not present in stock are ignored (no new keys, no error) — test_unknown_sku_reservations_are_ignored and test_unknown_sku_does_not_add_keys.
The input stock mapping is not mutated — test_input_stock_is_not_mutated asserts stock == {'A': 10} after call.
The input reservations sequence is not mutated — test_input_reservations_is_not_mutated asserts list unchanged after call.
Return type is a mapping with the same keys as the input stock — test_literal_example_returns_exact_mapping asserts type(result) is dict; test_return_keys_match_stock_keys asserts key equality.
Existing behavior for single reservations and multiple distinct SKUs is preserved — test_single_reservation_preserved and test_multiple_distinct_skus_preserved; test_empty_inputs covers empty case.

review_results.summary: The candidate implementation of available_units in inventory.py correctly subtracts all reservation quantities per SKU, including repeated entries, clamps at zero, ignores unknown SKUs, and preserves inputs. The literal example {'A':10} with [('A',2),('A',3)] returns {'A':5}. Regression evidence shows the two key tests failed on the original source ({'A':7}) and pass on the candidate. All acceptance contracts are satisfied with concrete test evidence.

contract_checks.evidence: inventory.py: available = dict(stock); loop subtracts each reservation. test_repeated_sku_reservations_are_all_subtracted and test_literal_example_returns_exact_mapping assert == {'A': 5}; both failed on baseline with {'A': 7} and pass on candidate.

contract_checks.requirement: All reservation quantities for a SKU are subtracted, including repeated SKU entries (no collapsing to last value).
contract_checks.evidence: The loop `for sku, qty in reservations: available[sku] = max(0, available[sku] - qty)` accumulates every tuple. Baseline used dict(reservations) collapsing to last value (7); candidate yields 5, confirmed by regression evidence.

contract_checks.requirement: Resulting available quantity is clamped at zero (never negative).
contract_checks.evidence: max(0, available[sku] - qty) applied per reservation. test_over_reservation_clamps_at_zero asserts {'A': 0} for reservations totaling 105 against stock 10.

contract_checks.requirement: Reservations for SKUs not present in stock are ignored (no new keys, no error).
contract_checks.evidence: `if sku in available` guard skips unknown SKUs. test_unknown_sku_reservations_are_ignored asserts {'A': 8}; test_unknown_sku_does_not_add_keys asserts result == {'A': 10} and keys == {'A'}.

contract_checks.requirement: The input stock mapping is not mutated.
contract_checks.evidence: available = dict(stock) creates a copy; mutations target the copy. test_input_stock_is_not_mutated asserts stock == {'A': 10} after the call.

contract_checks.requirement: The input reservations sequence is not mutated.
contract_checks.evidence: The loop only reads reservations; no assignment to it. test_input_reservations_is_not_mutated asserts reservations == [('A', 2), ('A', 3)] after the call.

contract_checks.requirement: Return type is a mapping with the same keys as the input stock.
contract_checks.evidence: Returns the dict copy `available`, initialized from stock, so keys match. test_literal_example_returns_exact_mapping asserts type(result) is dict; test_return_keys_match_stock_keys asserts set(result.keys()) == set(stock.keys()).

contract_checks.requirement: Existing behavior for single reservations and multiple distinct SKUs is preserved.
contract_checks.evidence: test_single_reservation_preserved asserts {'A': 8}; test_multiple_distinct_skus_preserved asserts {'A': 8, 'B': 4}; test_empty_inputs asserts {}; existing tests/test_contract.py test_existing_contract passes (12 passed total).
